title: Into the Abyss
notes: NEW: Abyss Rift (from Master League). Endless run: HP carries over, pick 1 of 3 boons after every win, Rift Lords drop permanent relics.
NEW: Master unlocks at Master Lv 1, 10, 20 ... 90, 99: rare and mythic boons, reroll, Blood Pact curses, Second Wind, Deep Dive, up to 4 relic slots, Ascension.
NEW: Master Gate. Its level follows your Master League level, so its loot keeps up. The Rift drops scaling items too.
NEW: Spirit Awakening. After Lv 15 spirits gain stars (up to 10): +25% bolt damage each. Costs Gold and Mana Stones.
Legion: one-click Remove on every slot. Put in slot no longer replaces a random spirit.
Master League: no more one-shots. Masters have much more HP but hit far less hard, fights last 10-40 s.
Economy: enhancing costs about 35% less Gold, Mana Stone cost now grows with item level.
Endgame levels no longer explode: from Lv 70 each level needs XP in line with the rewards.
